verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance documents a Sandbox project on the non-billable, unlimited Test Drive plan with access to all API endpoints. It also documents test banks (FinBanks), a test payroll provider (FinPayroll) and testing personas with varied profiles and data for different scenarios. That covers test institutions and data retrieval, but the pack never shows specific test credentials, error-state simulation, or an end-to-end Connect linking flow inside the sandbox. Missing for 10: documented test usernames/passwords, documented error-state or failure test scenarios, explicit sandbox linking walkthrough via Connect, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a sandbox with test institutions and documented test credentials lets me exercise linking, data retrieval, and error states end-to-end before touching a real bank account

citations.quote: A Sandbox project gives you access to the Open Finance Test Drive plan. Test Drive is a non-billable, unlimited plan that provides access to all Open Finance API endpoints.
you will learn how to use our test banks (FinBanks) and test payroll provider (FinPayroll). You will get access to a wide variety of profiles and data to test different types of use case scenarios.
we provide you with a set of testing personas. Each persona represents an example of a user who might use your app.
